name: Falci del plenilunio
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create an ORIGINAL wide 16:9 full-page painterly anime fantasy Oculum background. PRIMARY SCENE: An earthly sanctuary of the lost GOOD Moon: silver crescent carvings on a low memorial, blue flowers, a carefully mended lunar banner watched over by tiny allied star lights. The actual sky is EMPTY of the Moon. Melancholic indigo and silver, protective rather than sinister. Composition: illustrate the whole page naturally, with a quiet darker centre for readable controls, no empty rectangular panels. Matte hand-painted gouache and restrained anime fantasy linework, attractive deliberate shapes, believable construction and materials, detailed but uncluttered, no glossy 3D. The first reference is ONLY for painterly technique; do NOT copy its objects, geography, sunset or lighting. No sun disc, no eye in the sky. Lunar lore: the Moon was good, is now dead and absent from the sky. Lunar and star symbols are allied and protective. Most devils are lunar allies. Use lunar symbols only as physical carvings or relics. No coins, no currency discs, no Obser, no engraved eyes as generic decorations. Any clouds present naturally in the scene mix luminous BLUE dominant, then INDIGO, VIOLET and PASTEL PINK. Do not force clouds indoors. Tell the story ONLY through image details. NO writing, text, UI, logos, watermarks. Do not repeat the previous theme's composition, relic or environment.
